skill.summary: Lethe — persistent memory layer for AI agents. Handles startup orientation, active memory queries, proactive recall, decision recording, and flag management....

latestVersion.changelog:
lethe 0.1.8

- Clarified Lethe server must only run locally—do not expose externally.
- Improved session handling: sessions must be created dynamically via the API when not found; removed hardcoded/fallback session IDs to avoid event mixing.
- Updated skill notes to specify local CLI path (`lethe-log` is in the root skill directory, not under scripts/).
- Added explicit warning that setting LETHE_API will send data off-machine (reserved for a future SaaS mode).
- Documentation and startup instructions updated for clarity and accurate API usage.
